description: List one Dallas County or Collin County, Texas property's county tax-foreclosure sale listings (lead_id, or county with account): whether it is on a sale list now and the next sale date, then each listing's sale date, status (scheduled, awaiting a sale date, struck off and offered for resale, sold, cancelled), cause number, minimum bid, judgment, adjudged value and a link to the source notice. Dallas County from Linebarger's tax-sale listings, Collin County from the constables' sale notices, updated weekly. Bid and judgment figures come from the sale notice and are not sale prices. To find listed properties, use filter_properties with the tax_sale_listed attribute. Counts as a property lookup. Read-only.

account.description: Appraisal-district account number; pass with county instead of lead_id

county.description: Dallas or Collin (Texas). No other county is covered.

lead_id.description: RBSHome property id, County:account, for example 'Collin:2771234' or 'Dallas:00000776655'

name: get_tax_sale_history
title: Tax-foreclosure sale listings
